title: PA3: Policy-Aware Agent Alignment through Chain-of-Thought
abstract: arXiv:2603.14602v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Conversational assistants powered by large language models (LLMs) excel at tool-use tasks but struggle with adhering to complex, business-specific rules. While models can reason over business rules provided in context, including all policies for every query introduces high latency and wastes compute. Furthermore, these lengthy prompts lead to long contexts, harming overall performance due to the 'needle-in-a-haystack' problem. To address these challenges, we propose a multi-stage alignment method that teaches models to recall and apply relevant business policies during chain-of-thought reasoning at inference time, without including the full business policy in-context. Furthermore, we introduce a novel Policy Recall reward based on the Jaccard score and a Hallucination Penalty for GRPO training. translated_title: PA3：通过思维链实现策略感知的智能体对齐
translated_abstract: 由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的对话助手在工具使用任务上表现出色，但在遵循复杂的、业务特定的规则方面却存在困难。虽然模型能够对上下文中提供的业务规则进行推理，但为每个查询都包含所有策略会带来高延迟并浪费计算资源。此外，这些冗长的提示会导致上下文过长，由于“大海捞针”问题而损害整体性能。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种多阶段对齐方法，教会模型在推理时通过思维链推理回忆并应用相关的业务策略，而无需在上下文中包含完整的业务策略。此外，我们引入了一种基于Jaccard分数的新型策略召回奖励以及用于GRPO训练的幻觉惩罚。总体而言，我们的最佳模型比基线高出16分，并超越了规模相近的上下文内基线……
tldr: 提出PA3多阶段对齐方法，通过思维链推理让模型在推理时自动回忆并应用相关业务策略，并引入基于Jaccard分数的策略召回奖励和幻觉惩罚用于GRPO训练，无需在上下文中包含完整业务策略即可遵循复杂业务规则，性能比基线提升16分。
en_tdlr: PA3 is a multi-stage alignment method that teaches LLM agents to recall and apply relevant business policies during chain-of-thought reasoning at inference time, using a novel Jaccard-based Policy Recall reward and a Hallucination Penalty for GRPO training, outperforming baselines by 16 points without including full policies in-context.
